artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with undulating hills in the distance, a prominent hill in the foreground, and softer hills beyond. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic color palette with controlled shading techniques. A figure is seen on a railway boxcar in the foreground, with train tracks leading into the midground. A small house is nestled among trees to the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Untitled (Hauling Out a Log)

artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures working with a large piece of machinery. The drawing depicts muscular figures using their bodies to manipulate the industrial machine. The figures are arranged dynamically with strong lines and shading emphasizing their forms. The setting suggests an industrial or rural environment, with abstracted lines in the background. The composition creates a sense of intensity and laborious activity.

artworks.dimensions:

sheet: 291 x 347 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a winding path flanked by rocky formations. A lone rider on horseback travels along the path. In the background, distant hills stretch across the horizon. The artist uses intricate etching techniques with fine, curved lines to create textures on the rocks, and subtle, horizontal lines for the distant hills. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray to emphasize the rugged terrain and create a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Untitled (Everyone's A Critic)

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist painting, with a group of figures observing. The central figure is painting a structure on a canvas on an easel. Surrounding the artist are figures watching attentively, each with distinctive postures and expressions. The scene includes elements of architecture and a pathway extending into the background. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing textures and shading for depth and form.

artworks.title: High Level Bridge Over Harlem
artworks.dimensions:
image: 248 x 305 mm
paper: 311 x 343 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from beneath a large archway, looking out into a landscape with a hillside town in the distance. The arch frames the town, creating depth. The horizon is at the top of the image, with buildings on rolling hills. The artwork uses intricate, precise lines to create texture. The color palette is only black and white, emphasizing contrast and linearity. In the foreground, two figures near a street lamp interact, and in the distance, a path winds around hills toward buildings. The sky has swirling lines suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: Eve Repentant
artworks.dimensions:
image: 330 x 475 mm
sheet:  451 x 610 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on the ground with legs extended forward, bent at the elbows and fingers intertwined around the toes. The person's head is resting on the knees, with long, wavy hair cascading down the back. The individual is unclothed. In the background, there is a large tree trunk and branches with foliage, casting shadows. There is a round object near the person's foot. The sepia tone of the image gives it a warm, monochromatic look.

sheet: 198 x 226 mm

artworks.description: This is a drawing of ducks behind a fence. The image shows several ducks positioned behind a mesh wire fence. The ducks are depicted with distinctive strokes that convey their textures and patterns. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style, highlighting the detail in the drawing and creating a sense of depth. Shading and crosshatching are used to add dimensionality to the composition.

artworks.title: The Plaza Hotel

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with a tall, ornate building. The horizon line is low, aligning with the base of the building, street, and surrounding urban elements. The artwork features a sketch-like style with thin lines and a sepia color palette. There are early 20th-century automobiles, pedestrians, and buildings in the scene.

artworks.title: The New York Light Guard's Quick Step: As Performed by Dodworth's Brass Band. Composed and Respectfully Dedicated to the Officers and Members of the Light Guard; by Francis H. Brown
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two uniformed figures in ceremonial attire with ships and a lineup of soldiers in the background. The image features two figures standing prominently at the foreground, dressed in full military regalia including tall hats with plumes, epaulettes, sashes, and tailored coats. Behind them is a formation of soldiers lined up with similar attire. In the background, there are sailing ships on the water, giving a sense of a harbor or coastline setting. The drawing includes the title "THE NEW YORK LIGHT GUARD'S" at the top, with additional text at the bottom, likely related to a musical piece titled "QUICK STEP" dedicated to the officers and members.

artworks.title: Ten Pound Island Gloucester
artworks.dimensions:
image: 307 x 469 mm
sheet:  444 x 589 mm
plate:   368 x 504 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a dark, calm ocean illuminated by moonlight. The horizon sits just above the midpoint, with silhouetted ships to the right and a distant lighthouse emitting a beam of light to the left. The sky is filled with heavy, textured clouds, with the moon casting a glow and shimmering reflections on the water. The color palette is predominantly gray and muted, creating a mysterious and serene atmosphere. The brushstrokes are detailed, enhancing the image's depth.

artworks.title: A Bright Outlook
artworks.dimensions:
image: 444 x 316 mm
sheet:  648 x 475 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image portrays a young boy standing with a slightly angled posture. He has a youthful face with large eyes and a subtle smile. He has short, wavy hair, partially covered by a cap, and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, suspenders, knee-length, tattered pants, and worn-out, mismatched shoes. He is holding a small box or case associated with shoe-shining. The background is a textured, plain surface.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.dimensions:
image: 304 x 456 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  502 x 636 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with two figures walking along a path by a large boulder and various trees. The trees form a dense canopy overhead. A calm river runs horizontally in the middle distance, meeting the land. Across the river, there are rustic buildings with defined forms. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, resembling etching. The color palette is sepia, creating a warm, nostalgic feel. The composition highlights contrasts between light and shadow, reflected in the water. The background sky has subtle horizontal clouds.

artworks.title: Infantry in Arms
artworks.dimensions:
image: 246 x 406 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  454 x 601 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a young child standing beside her. She is seated to the left of a dining table, in profile, with the child leaning against her. The woman has light hair styled up and is wearing a detailed dress with long sleeves and a high collar. The young child has long, wavy hair and is dressed in a light frock with stockings and shoes. Another young child, with short hair, is visible sitting at the table wearing a dark dress. On the right side, a woman is standing, holding a toddler dressed in a light outfit. The standing woman is wearing a long dress with a dark top and a white apron and headpiece, looking at the adults. The dining area is decorated with a table set with dishes and glassware. Behind them is an ornate wall with framed art, a large urn, plants, and a fireplace topped with a mantel holding decorative china and vases. The room has a rug, chandelier, and patterned walls, creating a sophisticated and classic ambiance.

artworks.title: New York Harbor
artworks.dimensions:
image: 325 x 751 mm
sheet:  387 x 774 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of a boat on water with a cityscape in the distance. The horizon is low in the composition, emphasizing the vast sky. The Statue of Liberty is visible on the horizon surrounded by ships' masts. A steamboat close by emits smoke as it moves across the water. The brushstrokes vary, creating motion in the water. The details of the boats are precise. The color scheme is sepia, giving the image a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Near the Coast [large plate]
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an expansive sky filled with swirling clouds rendered in detailed hatching. The horizon line sits low above distant water and land. Fine lines create texture and depth, portraying movement in the clouds and trees. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and black. The foreground features grasses, shrubs, and a twisted tree with bare swaying branches. In the distance, smaller trees and bushes are visible amidst light and shadows.

artworks.description: The image shows two large sailboats racing side by side on the sea. The horizon is visible above the boats. The brushstrokes are smooth and detailed, emphasizing the texture of the sails and the movement of the boats. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using shades of black, white, and gray. Light and shadow across the sails provide depth and motion to the scene.

artworks.title: Tivoli
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 179 x 248 mm
sheet: 211 x 285 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a cliffside village on a promontory, surrounded by lush vegetation and rocky terrain. The point of view is elevated, showing the landscape with the horizon high in the composition. The densely packed structures and trees limit the view of the sky. The etching technique gives intricate detail to the stone buildings and surroundings, creating a variety of tonal values. The color palette is monochromatic with warm sepia and beige tones. Foliage and shrubs are detailed in the foreground, leading to rocky terrain and the village perched on the cliff edge in the distance.

artworks.title: Second Avenue
artworks.dimensions:
image: 178 x 254 mm
paper: 228 x 332 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling urban scene from a street-level point of view. A prominent elevated railroad or structure frames the top of the composition, casting a shadow and drawing the eye across the scene. The horizon line is positioned towards the top, just above the buildings, with a fragment of the sky visible. The buildings, likely made of brick and adorned with awnings, dominate the image, housing a busy produce market with numerous figures engaged in various activities. The brushstrokes or etching technique is detailed, defined by strong, intersecting lines that create deep textures and contrasts. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing the detailed lines and providing a classic, historical feel to the scene, enhancing the intricacy of city life depicted.

artworks.title: Farmer's Nooning
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people resting under a tree. Some are lying or sitting on the grass, while others lean against the tree trunk. In the distance are fields with haystacks or harvest sheaves. The sky above is filled with fluffy clouds. The painting is detailed with fine brushstrokes, focusing on textures of grass and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young girl with long, light hair seated and turned slightly to the side. She has her eyes closed and appears serene. She is wearing a laced, high-collared garment with puffed sleeves and an intricate lace collar underneath. In her hand, she holds a thin stem with a feathery tip. The background is a dark, shadowy expanse.

artworks.title: The Fisherman's Song
artworks.dimensions:
image: 603 x 329 mm
paper: 694 x 537 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of fishermen walking along a path in a coastal village. The scene captures several fishermen walking along a dirt or muddy pathway lined with simple wooden buildings on one side and a wire fence on the other. In the background, there are additional structures and a calm body of water extending to the horizon where a small sailboat is depicted. The atmosphere is informal and lively, with the print using subtle shades and careful detailing to convey texture and depth, highlighting the clothing and expressions of the figures as well as the rugged landscape.

The landscape includes dense foliage, a wooden fence, and a horizon with clouds. The color palette is sepia with detailed brushstrokes defining the figures and elements. In the background, there is a small silhouette of a house on a hill.

artworks.title: Drifting

artworks.description: The image features a seascape with sailboats in a sepia-toned etching style. The horizon is high, with sailboats dominating the view. A sailboat closest to the viewer creates ripples in the water, reflecting its sails. Other vessels of different sizes can be seen in the distance, including steamships. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, providing a detailed look. The color palette is subdued with warm sepia tones, evoking a classic feel.
